Privacy policy

How this website handles conversion inputs and browser settings.

Last updated: October 25, 2026.

Conversion inputs

The converter code processes your input in your browser. It does not send dates, numbers, or text to a conversion server, and it does not save conversion history.

Theme preference

The site stores your selected light or dark theme in localStorage under the key convertly-theme. You can remove it by clearing this website’s browser data.

Hosting and access

Your browser requests website files from the hosting provider. That provider may process connection information such as IP addresses and request logs. A private Sites deployment may also require the owner’s authentication; that access layer is separate from this website’s converter code.

Advertising and analytics

This version does not load advertising or analytics scripts. If advertising is enabled later, this policy must be updated with the actual providers and data practices, and applicable consent controls must be implemented before those scripts load.

Clipboard

Copy buttons write only the selected result to your clipboard when you click them. The website does not read your clipboard.

Contact

Operator contact details have not yet been configured. This deployment is an owner preview and must have a working contact channel before public launch.
